purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Emergency Intake & Chief Complaint' screen within workflow WF_004.
preconditions: Patient has presented to the emergency department and been registered
postconditions: All required fields on 'Emergency Intake & Chief Complaint' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm chief complaint is captured in the patient's or reporter's own words before triage begins
Confirm arrival time is logged automatically, not manually entered
common_errors: Chief complaint field copied from a prior visit rather than the current presentation
